premise: Owl tells the three sleepiest friends a story that gets slower and slower, word by word, until it is only hoo... hoo... and everyone is asleep.
inspiration: The story that never ends (folk endless-tale pattern), turned into a lullaby that winds down instead of looping.
lesson: The best bedtime story is the one you fall asleep in.

en-US.title: Owl's Slowest Story
en-US.text: Night in the forest. Mouse yawned. Hedgehog yawned. Frog yawned, which is very wide. Story, please, they said. Owl {owl:pulse} fluffed his feathers. Once upon a time, he said, there was a little mouse. Mouse {mouse:hop} sat up. Who walked through the forest, step, step, step. And met a hedgehog. Hedgehog {hedgehog:pulse} smiled. Who was rolling home, roll, roll, roll. And they met a frog. Frog {frog:hop} hopped. Who was hopping to the pond. Hop. Hop. And the moon came out. {owl:glow hold} And it was very... bright. And very... quiet. And the mouse... yawned. Mouse {mouse:fade-out hold} yawned. And the hedgehog... curled up. Hedgehog {hedgehog:fade-out hold} curled up. And the frog... Owl looked down. Frog {frog:fade-out hold} was already snoring. Owl smiled. And then, said Owl, very slowly, very softly... hoo. Hoo. Hoooo. And that was the end. Or maybe just the beginning of a dream.

es-ES.title: El cuento más lento de Búho
es-ES.text: Noche en el bosque. Ratón bostezó. Erizo bostezó. Rana bostezó, que es un bostezo muy grande. Un cuento, por favor, dijeron. Búho {owl:pulse} ahuecó las plumas. Érase una vez, dijo, un ratón pequeñito. Ratón {mouse:hop} se sentó. Que caminaba por el bosque, tip, tip, tip. Y se encontró con un erizo. Erizo {hedgehog:pulse} sonrió. Que iba rodando a casa, rueda, rueda, rueda. Y se encontraron con una rana. Rana {frog:hop} saltó. Que iba saltando al estanque. Salto. Salto. Y salió la luna. {owl:glow hold} Y estaba muy... brillante. Y muy... callada. Y el ratón... bostezó. Ratón {mouse:fade-out hold} bostezó. Y el erizo... se hizo una bola. Erizo {hedgehog:fade-out hold} se hizo una bola. Y la rana... Búho miró hacia abajo. Rana {frog:fade-out hold} ya roncaba. Búho sonrió. Y entonces, dijo Búho, muy despacio, muy bajito... uuuh. Uuuh. Uuuuuh. Y colorín colorado. O a lo mejor era el principio de un sueño.

sound.note: each hoo softer and longer than the last
